Dashboard.Intro: Your desktop, organized into one lightweight workspace hub.
Widgets.Intro: Native widgets are lightweight. WebView2 is reserved for rich HTML/video widgets.
DeskZones.Intro: FancyZones-style zones (PowerToys): hold Shift while dragging any window to see the screen's zones, and drop it inside one to snap it to that size automatically.
DeskZones.ShiftDragHint: Without Shift, dragging windows works exactly as normal — no interference. Each screen's layout is set here, not per individual zone.
DeskZones.ContainersIntro: Drag files or folders into a container to group them visually on the desktop. Press Space (or right-click → Quick Look) on an icon for a quick preview.
Wallpaper.Intro: One engine for live (video playlist) or procedural (MotionDesk Waves) backgrounds, with performance modes and automatic battery savings.
Wallpaper.SupportedFormats: Supported formats: MP4, M4V, WebM, MOV, OGV, OGG, AVI, MKV, WMV, MPEG, MPG, M2TS, TS. Anything that can't play (e.g. an exotic codec in AVI/WMV) is automatically skipped to the next one.
Wallpaper.PerScreenNote: A screen with a pinned video doesn't take part in the shared playlist's shuffle/advance.
Profiles.Intro: Save your entire desktop setup and load it back with one click.
Performance.Intro: Live hardware overview, without a separate PerformanceCounter per widget.
Automation.Intro: Rules like: when an application starts → load a workspace profile.
About.Body: This build uses a real application shell while desktop overlays remain independently managed.
About.CapabilitiesList: Native widgets • snap-to-grid • multi-monitor recovery • DeskZone layouts • live wallpaper • audio visualizer • profiles • automation • command palette • tray integration • global hotkeys • battery-aware performance modes • light/dark theme • EL/EN language.
About.ShortcutsList:
Ctrl+1…9  Go to page (menu order)
Ctrl+0  Personalization (IconAtlas/DeskCursors/DeskStrip/DeskSounds)
Ctrl+K  Command Palette
Ctrl+B  Collapse/expand sidebar
Ctrl+E  Enable/Disable Wallpaper
Ctrl+Shift+N  New DeskZone
Ctrl+,  Settings
F1  About MotionDesk Studio
F5  Refresh current page
Ctrl+Alt+F  Flip 3D (window switcher, global)
Ctrl+Alt+G  Toggle Gaming/Work profile (global)
Ctrl+Alt+M  Show main window (global)
Common.NoPinnedApps: No pinned apps yet — drag one onto the dock, or use "Pin application…".
Personalization.Intro: The safe, registry/native-API-only pieces of the customization vision — no system files are modified. Everything here is reversible with the Reset/Clear buttons.
Personalization.IconAtlasIntro: Change the icon for This PC and the Recycle Bin (empty/full), or set a custom icon for any folder — the same desktop.ini mechanism Explorer itself uses.
Personalization.DeskCursorsIntro: Assign a custom cursor per role. Roles left unset keep whatever Windows is already using — nothing is overwritten unless you pick a file for it.
Personalization.DeskStripIntro: A floating dock of pinned apps, bottom-center of your primary screen. Drag a file onto it, or use "Pin application…". Auto-hide isn't built yet — see the roadmap.
Personalization.DeskSoundsIntro: Assign a custom .wav per system event — the same official mechanism as the classic Windows Sound scheme picker.
Personalization.ThemePackagesIntro: Windows' own theme package format — bundles wallpaper, cursors and sound scheme into one file, applied through Windows' own theme handler. Not a visual-style engine: window/button shapes aren't changed.
Personalization.LockScreenIntro: Uses the same Personalization CSP mechanism MDM/Intune tools use. Requires an administrator prompt (writes to a machine-wide setting) — asked for fresh each time, only for this one action.
Personalization.LockScreenEditionNote: Detected edition: {0}. This is documented to work on Pro/Enterprise/Education; on Home edition Windows may silently ignore it.
Personalization.LockScreenFailed: Could not confirm the change took effect (possibly ignored by this Windows edition).
Settings.UiSoundCues: UI sound cues (system sounds on key actions)
Settings.WallpaperNote: Video playlist, MotionDesk Waves themes and performance modes are configured on the Wallpaper Studio page.
Settings.AutoPerformanceMode: Automatically use Battery/Low Power wallpaper mode
